verdict.rationale: Retell documents a public API. Its official Node.js and Python SDKs claim full voice and chat endpoint coverage with API-key auth and structured errors, there is a published API reference (e.g. clone-voice), and the CLI and MCP server both drive the platform via Retell APIs. The founder also describes the product as focused on the voice AI API part. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), broader API-reference evidence beyond a single endpoint page, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform via the API.
